messages:
Maya: quick heads-up, HF->Redwood conversion for hf/org/opus-7b-pt dropped tokenizer_config.json on the artifact. fast tokenizer not present so runtime falls back to slow. saw a regression in our quantized int8 evals (ROUGE ~1.6% down). attaching logs below.
Liam: @Maya can you paste the artifact ls? did the conversion script warn about missing files?
Maya: here's ls from the model repo after conversion:
```
-rw-r--r-- 1 root root  12M Apr  5 12:02 merges.txt
-rw-r--r-- 1 root root  34K Apr  5 12:02 vocab.json
-rw-r--r-- 1 root root  1.2K Apr  5 12:02 tokenizer.json
-rw-r--r-- 1 root root  4.1K Apr  5 12:02 config.json
# NOTE: tokenizer_config.json is missing
```
Maya: conversion log shows: `WARN: no tokenizer_config.json, assuming slow-tokenizer semantics`
so runtime loads slow path which changes special token indices (esp <|sep|> mapping) :/  
Jordan: hmm, merges.txt present but tokenizer_config missing — that usually means the HF model packaged a fast tokenizer (tokenizer.json) but didn't ship the extra metadata. fast vs slow mismatch is exactly our old pain.
Samir: does the slow path actually change token ids or just special token names? we saw similar files where special mappings were in tokenizer_config.json and absent caused index shifts.
Maya: quick diff of token id for "[PAD]": fast loader -> id 0, slow loader -> id 1 in this model. small change but cascades into tokenization of prompts and eval metrics.
Liam: reproduce commands? I can run local converter with --debug
Maya: reproduce sequence: `python convert_hf_to_redwood.py --src hf/org/opus-7b-pt --out /tmp/opus-redwood --keep-fast` logs: `converted tokenizer.json` then `no tokenizer_config.json -> creating minimal fallback` but our converter currently writes a minimal fallback that doesn't include `special_tokens_map` so runtime still picks slow semantics. full snippet:
```
# converter fallback
{
  "name_or_path": "opus-7b-pt",
  "tokenizer_class": "AddedToken",
  # missing special_tokens_map
}
```
Jordan: could we derive special_tokens_map from tokenizer.json heuristics? like detect common tokens `<|sep|>`, `<|system|>` by name->id mapping and synthesize tokenizer_config.json
Samir: yes, create a heuristic step: if tokenizer_config.json missing but tokenizer.json present and merges.txt present -> synthesize tokenizer_config.json that includes `special_tokens_map` and `model_max_length` and the `tokenizer_class: PreTrainedTokenizerFast`.
Samir: quick patch idea (one-liner): `jq '.special_tokens_map = {"bos_token":"<s>","eos_token":"</s>","sep_token":"<|sep|>"}' tokenizer.json > tokenizer_config.json` (very rough but workable as stopgap)
Liam: tryable, but we must be careful — different models use different special token names. maybe better to attempt to read `special_tokens_map` from huggingface `tokenizer.json` fields like `added_tokens` or `special_tokens_map` if present.
Maya: I pushed a small branch `fix/derive-token-config` with a heuristic and test; main problem is some models have numeric-only added tokens so names aren't guaranteed. ran quick eval after heuristic: ROUGE drop reduced to ~0.2% (so majority of regression fixed)
eval-bot: eval run #1758882468: model opus-7b-pt converted-with-heuristic -> rouge-1: 0.412 vs baseline 0.414, rouge-2: 0.188 vs 0.190, pass threshold? borderline.
Maya: follow-up: still seeing a few generation truncations under int8 runtime due to kv-cache key mismatch if vocab shift occurs. this is low frequency but shows up on long-context summarization tests.
Jordan: action items: 1) converter should synthesize tokenizer_config.json from tokenizer.json whenever HF token files are incomplete (fast-only). 2) add unit test that loads both fast and slow tokenizers and verifies token id parity for special tokens. 3) add a preflight in onboarding pipeline that fails onboarding if tokenizer_config absent and heuristic can't confidently map specials.
Samir: agreed. also log a warning that quantization/eval should run after the heuristic and compare tokenization outputs for a small prompt set — fail if >1% tokenization divergence.
Liam: assigned to me, I'll land the synthesize step and the quick token parity test. will also add a small migration script to run against already-hosted artifacts and patch in tokenizer_config.json where safe.
Maya: thanks. @build-bot can we kick a canary deploy of converter v0.9.3-fix to dedicated staging?
build-bot: deploy started for converter-v0.9.3-fix -> staging (pool: conv-staging) :rocket:
build-bot: deploy succeeded in 3m 12s :white_check_mark:
eval-bot: post-deploy eval: 10-sample quickcheck token parity reduced mismatches from 14 -> 1, full eval pending.
Maya: great. I'll open an onboarding ticket to re-run quantized evals once migration script has patched artifacts. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
